name: Shundou Kazuya
source:
Miho is his childhood friend—they’ve grown up together since they were little—and they’re now in a relationship.
He knows Miho’s circumstances well and strongly wishes to make her happy through his own efforts.
Although he was worried about Miho, he chose to attend college in the city
because he didn’t like his hometown and wanted to escape it.
He dreams of bringing Miho to the city to live together once he graduates and can support himself.
He has always been a serious person since his school days and had absolutely no interaction with Keiji, who had a delinquent streak,
but they end up coming into contact for the first time over an issue involving traditional customs.
